summary.zh: 用容器查询与流式排版做自适应布局
summary.en: Responsive layouts with container queries and fluid type.

description.zh: 借助容器查询、流式字号、CSS Grid 与移动优先的断点策略，构建适配不同屏幕的布局。适合给成熟页面补多端适配，或为单个组件定义响应行为。
description.en: Builds layouts that adapt across screens with container queries, fluid typography, CSS Grid, and mobile-first breakpoints. Fits retrofitting existing pages or defining responsive behavior per component.
